project-charter.title: Observe the Automotive Drivetrain

cards.title: Client Brief & Design Scope
cards.body: Mahindra & Mahindra Automotive Drivetrain R&D Division requires you to perform a fatigue design and strength verification of an automotive propeller shaft subjected to fluctuating torque loads during acceleration, gear changes, and road travel.

cards.title: Automotive Power Transmission Chain
cards.body:
Engine → Gearbox → Propeller Shaft → Universal Joints / Splines → Differential → Rear Axle → Rear Wheels.

The propeller shaft experiences repeated cyclic torsional fluctuations throughout vehicle service life. It cannot be sized purely for static peak torque; it must be designed against torsional fatigue failure.

cards.title: Engineering Objectives
items: Identify the propeller shaft components on Engineering Asset EA-16.
Trace the torque transmission path from transmission gearbox to differential.
Identify critical stress concentration sections (splined joint, weld fillets).
Calculate mean and alternating torque components under fluctuating operation.
Apply modified Soderberg torsional fatigue criteria to size/verify shaft diameter.

project-charter.acceptanceText: I have read and understood the EA-16 Project Charter for Automotive Propeller Shaft Fatigue Design.

component-identification.title: Identify Drivetrain Components
component-identification.description: Student engineering asset illustrating automotive propeller shaft assembly and rear axle drive connection.

labels.feedback: Flanged coupling connecting transmission gearbox output shaft to propeller shaft.
Cardan universal joint accommodating angular misalignment at gearbox exit.
Axially sliding splined joint accommodating changes in distance as suspension moves.
Main hollow steel tubular shaft transmitting drive torque over wheelbase length.
Rear Hooke's joint transmitting torque to differential input pinion.
Bevel pinion shaft driving rear axle differential crown wheel.
Rigid axle casing supporting differential gears and live axle shafts.
Drive wheel transferring traction force to road surface.

torque-transmission-path.title: Understand Torque Transmission & Load Path
torque-transmission-path.prompt: Analyze how engine torque is multiplied by the transmission and transmitted via the propeller shaft.

mcq.question: Which option correctly states the sequence of torque flow and load transmission in a rear-wheel drive vehicle?

options.label: Engine → Transmission Gearbox → Front Universal Joint → Splined Slip Joint → Tubular Shaft → Rear Universal Joint → Differential → Rear Wheels
Rear Wheels → Tubular Shaft → Engine → Differential → Transmission Gearbox → Slip Joint
Transmission Gearbox → Differential → Front Universal Joint → Rear Wheels → Engine
Differential → Rear Axle → Engine → Tubular Shaft → Transmission Gearbox

critical-sections-stress-concentration.title: Identify Critical Shaft Sections & Stress Concentration
critical-sections-stress-concentration.prompt: Identify the critical sections of the propeller shaft assembly where fatigue cracks are most likely to initiate.

mcq.question: Where are the primary stress concentration zones ($K_t$) located on the propeller shaft assembly?

options.label: At the root of the splined slip joint teeth and the circumferential weld neck joining the tube to the universal joint yokes.
At the exact midpoint of the smooth, un-welded hollow tube section.
Inside the rubber tyre tread compound on the rear wheels.
On the smooth outer cylindrical surface of the transmission gearbox housing.

fluctuating-torsional-loading.title: Analyze Fluctuating Torsional Loading
fluctuating-torsional-loading.prompt: During vehicle operation, torque fluctuates between maximum acceleration ($T_{max} = 1500\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$) and steady cruising ($T_{min} = 300\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$).

mcq.question: What are the mean torque ($T_m$) and alternating torque ($T_a$) acting on the propeller shaft?

options.label: Mean Torque Tm = 900 N.m, Alternating Torque Ta = 600 N.m
Mean Torque Tm = 1500 N.m, Alternating Torque Ta = 300 N.m
Mean Torque Tm = 1800 N.m, Alternating Torque Ta = 1200 N.m
Mean Torque Tm = 600 N.m, Alternating Torque Ta = 900 N.m

fatigue-strength-factors.title: Determine Fatigue Strength Factors
fatigue-strength-factors.prompt: Evaluate the endurance limit modification factors ($k_a, k_b, k_c$) for a machined steel propeller shaft under torsional fatigue.

mcq.question: How is the modified endurance limit in shear ($S_{se}$) calculated from the ultimate tensile strength ($S_{ut}$)?

options.label: S_se = k_a * k_b * k_c * 0.577 * (0.5 * S_ut), applying surface, size, reliability factors and distortion energy shear conversion.
S_se = S_ut * 2.5 without any size or surface corrections.
S_se = S_yt / 0.577 with zero fatigue modification.
S_se = k_a * S_ut * 10.0.

fatigue-design-criterion.title: Apply Torsional Fatigue Design Criterion
fatigue-design-criterion.prompt: Apply the modified Soderberg fatigue criterion for fluctuating torsional shear stress.

mcq.question: Which equation represents the Soderberg relationship for fluctuating torsional shear stress?

options.label: (tau_m / S_sy) + (tau_a / S_se) = 1 / FoS
(tau_m + tau_a) * S_ut = FoS
tau_m / tau_a = S_se / S_sy
(tau_m / S_ut)^2 - (tau_a / S_se)^2 = FoS

options.title: SELECT HOLLOW TUBULAR SHAFT (HIGH STIFFNESS-TO-WEIGHT RATIO & HIGH CRITICAL SPEED)
options.description: Hollow shaft places material at outer radius maximizing polar section modulus (Zp) and polar moment of inertia (J), providing superior torsional fatigue resistance and higher critical whirling speed at much lower weight.

options.title: SELECT SOLID STEEL BAR SHAFT
options.description: Solid shaft is unnecessarily heavy, has low mass-specific polar moment of inertia, and suffers from lower natural whirling frequency under long automotive wheelbases.

components.name: Fretting Wear & Tooth Deformation at Splined Slip Joint
components.label: Spline Contact Fatigue Failure Mode

options.title: MAXIMUM SHEAR & DIAGONAL TENSION FATIGUE (45° CRACK) & SPLINE FRETTING CORROSION
options.description: 45-degree spiral crack is characteristic of principal tensile stress failure under cyclic torsion in ductile/semi-ductile material; spline tooth fretting results from cyclic axial sliding under heavy torque transfer.

options.title: PURE BENDING OVERLOAD & BUCKED TUBE AXIAL CRUSHING
options.description: Pure axial crushing causes local compression buckling rather than 45° spiral fatigue cracking across the tube body.

questions.label: 1. Drivetrain Load Path & Critical Section Identification

questions.label: 2. Fluctuating Torsional Stress & Soderberg Fatigue Analysis

questions.label: 3. Shaft Construction & Failure Mode Insights
questions.placeholder: Justify selecting a hollow tubular shaft over a solid bar, and explain 45-degree spiral torsional fatigue cracking and spline maintenance.
